a.lede: The ruling bars the United States Postal Service from implementing restrictions that experts and election officials say would upend voting in November.
a.title: The Supreme Court Just Blocked Trump’s Efforts to Control Mail-In Voting for the Midterms

b.lede: 197 election deniers are running for Congress or statewide office in 43 states. Many of them are seeking roles that would put them in charge of voting for the 2028 presidential election.
b.title: Hundreds of Election Deniers Will Be on the Ballot This November
